cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery with BMI ≥ 50 kg/m(2) (n=249) and an equal number with BMI 40-49.9 kg/m(2) (n=249) from 2009 to 2014
finding: Women with BMI ≥ 50 kg/m(2) had a significantly higher rate of wound separations after cesarean delivery compared to those with BMI 40-49.9 kg/m(2).
mod_finding: Women with a BMI ≥ 50 kg/m(2) had a higher rate of cesarean wound separations compared to those with a BMI of 40-49.9 kg/m(2).
